issues.issue: The Supplies and Other column includes all 4.44M of employee benefits (probably most of the Administration line, 5,017,131) plus purchased services. Tagging every department's line as supplies and materials overstates that object. The extractor says so in notes, but the lines carry no review flag.
The line mixes grants and contributions, and the grants may be government money (federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid). This is a category guess and is already marked for review.
This is operating 'Other revenue' with no breakdown in the trimmed PDF. 'other' is defensible and the line is marked for review; noted so it gets a look.
